verdict.rationale: Bench is a done-for-you bookkeeping service. Its only reconciliation claim is automatic separation of merchant fees from profits when tools are connected. That is a different feature from bank-to-ledger reconciliation, and nothing in the evidence shows an accountant reviewing matched, unmatched, or duplicate transactions per bank account. Bank connections and categorization are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can reconcile each bank account against the ledger with matched, unmatched, and duplicate transactions surfaced for review
